referencePolicy: User images inspire goal-to-journey structure and readable forms; not PM research evidence or product instructions.

states.label: ข้อมูลพร้อมแสดง
states.rule: Show scope, timestamp, evidence and permitted actions.

states.label: กำลังโหลด
states.rule: Preserve title/scope and show structural placeholders without fabricated values.

states.label: ยังไม่มีข้อมูล
states.rule: Explain whether no records or no filter matches; show authorized next action.

states.label: โหลดไม่สำเร็จ
states.rule: Readable redacted error, requestId and retry only for safe read.

states.label: ไม่มีสิทธิ์ / ไม่พบ
states.rule: Equivalent scoped error; do not reveal record names/counts; safe return link.

states.label: ข้อมูลยังไม่อัปเดต
states.rule: Show last update and reconnect; do not infer failed execution.

states.label: มีการแก้ไขรุ่นใหม่
states.rule: Preserve non-secret draft, show version diff and reload/reapply; no silent overwrite.

states.label: ข้อมูลไม่ครบ
states.rule: Error summary links to field or node; focus summary, then linked invalid field.

blocks.label: Project list with owner, dates and status

ux.goal: มองภาพรวมทุกโปรเจกต์ใน Business และเลือกงานที่ต้องตัดสินใจ
ux.interaction: Create Project ไป intake; แถว Project เปิด resource ที่ผ่านการตรวจสิทธิ์
ux.exception: ยังไม่มี Project: แสดง objective-first action
ux.responsive: Summary cards wrap; project table scrolls within region

ux.goal: เทียบงานข้ามโปรเจกต์โดยเห็น Project กำกับทุกแถว
ux.interaction: Filter Project/owner/date; row opens original Project without changing grants
ux.exception: ไม่มีงานตาม filter: Clear filters; ไม่มีสิทธิ์: ไม่แสดงชื่อโปรเจกต์
ux.responsive: Keep Project column; timeline has list alternative

ux.goal: รู้เป้าหมาย เจ้าของ workstream และหลักฐานที่ทำให้ progress เปลี่ยน
ux.interaction: Import Plan เปิด flow เดิม; workstream opens correct execution mode
ux.exception: ยังไม่มี workstream: objective/plan intake; progress UNKNOWN เมื่อไม่มีหลักฐาน
ux.responsive: Objective before metrics; workstreams stack

ux.goal: ค้น Domain ตาม owner และความรับผิดชอบ
ux.interaction: Domain card เปิด WF-05; filter does not create a Workstream
ux.exception: ยังไม่ได้ผูก Domain: เลือกจาก canonical registry ตามสิทธิ์
ux.responsive: Cards one column; names and stable keys wrap

ux.goal: ตรวจ lane ของ Domain และสัญญาที่ข้ามขอบเขต
ux.interaction: Open owned work; incoming/outgoing contract opens architecture inspector
ux.exception: ไม่มี owned work: อธิบาย contribution-only; ไม่ย้าย ownership อัตโนมัติ
ux.responsive: Charter first; contract relationships become a list

blocks.label: Outcome, primary owner and contributing domains

ux.goal: ค้น Feature ตามผลลัพธ์ผู้ใช้และ acceptance
ux.interaction: Feature row เปิด WF-07; contributing Domain chips เปิด Domain detail
ux.exception: ไม่มี Feature: authorized link/create requirement-backed draft
ux.responsive: Outcome and readiness stay visible; table scrolls

ux.goal: ติดตาม Requirement → Work → Test → Release ของ Feature เดียว
ux.interaction: Requirement opens WF-10; evidence opens exact revision; shared work deduplicated
ux.exception: ยังไม่มี acceptance evidence: แสดง missing evidence
ux.responsive: Trace chain vertical; no tiny graph text

blocks.label: One work dataset in the chosen view
Work item acceptance and evidence drawer

ux.goal: จัดและตรวจงานใน Project ผ่านหลาย view ของข้อมูลชุดเดียว
ux.interaction: Switch Work view preserves filters/scope; select row/board card opens work inspector
ux.exception: Filtered empty has reset; stale plan locks mutating actions until refreshed
ux.responsive: Board scrolls within board; table/graph offer text alternatives

blocks.label: Resolved scope and selected canonical mode

ux.goal: ใช้มุมมองที่เหมาะกับ executionMode ของ Workstream
ux.interaction: Select existing Workstream/mode; manual override lives in advanced settings
ux.exception: ยังไม่มี workstream ของ mode นี้: กลับ intake; invalid mode ไม่ fallback Sprint
ux.responsive: Stage board scrolls; details below selection

blocks.label: Trace links to spec, tests and work

ux.goal: จัด acceptance และ traceability ของ requirement
ux.interaction: Open draft, baseline diff, linked docs and evidence; request review pins revision
ux.exception: No linked requirement: authorized draft/link; ID collisions block review
ux.responsive: List/detail stack; long acceptance text wraps

blocks.label: Inspector with ports, contract, owner and errors

ux.goal: ตรวจ node, directed edge, owner และ contract ของ architecture
ux.interaction: Select node/edge inspector; validate draft; compare baseline; accessible list
ux.exception: No graph: import validated model; cross-owner WRITES blocks generation
ux.responsive: Canvas contained pan; inspector stacks; keyboard node/edge list

screens.title: API Explorer

blocks.label: Request, response, auth and error contract

screens.safety: No Try it out until exact environment/authority is selected; mutation uses payload review.

ux.goal: อ่าน API ตาม operation โดยเห็น auth/error/schema และ requirement
ux.interaction: Operation select updates detail; Try-it-out only in authorized sandbox with effect review
ux.exception: No selected operation: choose one; unavailable contract shows source error
ux.responsive: Operation list above detail; code areas contained scroll

ux.goal: อ่านและเทียบเอกสารแบบ revision-pinned
ux.interaction: Select doc/version; diff; review references exact content hash
ux.exception: Missing doc: link authorized source; broken reference remains visible
ux.responsive: Document reader first; comments and versions as sections

blocks.label: Selected run receipts and available commands

ux.goal: เห็น runs, approval queue, budget exposure และ stale heartbeats
ux.interaction: Select run opens WF-15; cancel/pause are commands with receipts
ux.exception: No run: select approved workflow; no authority means read-only queue
ux.responsive: Attention queue first; run columns within scroll region

screens.title: Run / Review / Recovery

blocks.label: Exact scope, version and action manifest

screens.safety: Retry is unavailable for unknown external outcome until reconciliation; cancellation request is not completion.

ux.goal: ตัดสินใจบน manifest/evidence และแก้ unknown effect อย่างตรวจสอบได้
ux.interaction: Review exact revision; reasoned approval; reconcile UNKNOWN before any retry
ux.exception: Missing evidence blocks approval; expired/stale hash requires new review
ux.responsive: Effect summary before trace; trace wraps

blocks.label: Search by domain, role and readiness

ux.goal: ค้น Agent definitions แยกจาก executable approved versions
ux.interaction: Select definition/version; create definition or next draft opens form
ux.exception: No agent: create scoped definition; membership grants no tool authority
ux.responsive: Inventory list then version inspector

blocks.label: Tools, context, model and executor policy

ux.goal: กำหนด instruction/tools/model/executor และ evaluation ของ agent version
ux.interaction: Edit draft; validate; evaluation evidence then review; approved version immutable
ux.exception: Missing references block review; conflict compares revisions
ux.responsive: Single-column fieldsets; binding tables scroll locally

ux.goal: กำหนด fleet membership, workflow, concurrency และ budgets
ux.interaction: Inventory selection opens version editor; validate resolved versions; review
ux.exception: Unbound agent/workflow or incompatible schema blocks approval
ux.responsive: Members list then workflow/policy

blocks.label: DAG with dependency and handoff edges
Step inputs, output schema and validation

ux.goal: สร้าง workflow ที่ทุก step มี owner,input,output,timeout/retry policy
ux.interaction: Node selection opens step schema; validate DAG and bindings; review before admission
ux.exception: Cycle/unknown field/owner mismatch shown in graph and error list
ux.responsive: Structured step list replaces drag-only editing

blocks.label: Authorized member table and allocation hints

ux.goal: ดูสมาชิกโปรเจกต์ บทบาท และขอบเขตที่ได้รับ
ux.interaction: Open membership detail; authorized role changes use existing identity boundary
ux.exception: No visible member: invite/link path only when allowed
ux.responsive: Name and role first; details expand

ux.goal: จัดไฟล์และหลักฐานตาม scope/version/audience
ux.interaction: Open provenance; share preview shows audience/expiry/redactions before action
ux.exception: No files: authorized upload; missing evidence does not imply deletion
ux.responsive: List then detail/share panel; long names wrap

ux.goal: เชื่อม repository metadata กับ Project และ evidence revision
ux.interaction: Open repository record; verified commit/check links when available
ux.exception: No repositories: add metadata; no mandatory GitHub API access
ux.responsive: Owner/name and role visible; paths wrap

blocks.label: Work, milestones, gates, files and team sections
Direct links to the one owning screen

ux.goal: ค้น inventory/index เดิมโดยไม่สร้าง writer ใหม่
ux.interaction: Read-only search and record links; source identity stays stable
ux.exception: No match: reset search; no generic asset-create action
ux.responsive: Search + semantic list; identifiers wrap

blocks.label: Model, MCP and executor readiness with probe date
Authorized binding edit and shared-registry link

ux.goal: ดู connection ที่ Project ใช้และกลับไปจัดการ Business registry
ux.interaction: Select authorized version binding; Manage registry → WF-32 with return context
ux.exception: Unconfigured: bind approved resource; no secret entry here
ux.responsive: Usage list then binding inspector

blocks.label: Effort and budget summary with unknown values

ux.goal: วาง capacity allocation และเห็น cost ที่มีที่มา
ux.interaction: Allocate resource with dates/effort; override requires reason and authority
ux.exception: No cost receipt: UNKNOWN; concurrent capacity conflict distinct
ux.responsive: Summary + single-column allocation

ux.goal: รับผิดชอบ risk/issue พร้อม mitigation, due date และ links
ux.interaction: Open risk, edit draft, link blocking work; close requires evidence
ux.exception: No risks: create scoped risk; foreign refs rejected
ux.responsive: Register then detail; probability/impact separate

blocks.label: Tests, build, migration and release evidence

ux.goal: ตัดสิน readiness จาก evidence ที่ตรง revision/environment
ux.interaction: Select baseline; inspect tests/deploy/activation separately; release review
ux.exception: No deploy receipt stays not deployed even with green CI
ux.responsive: Evidence stages vertical; exact revision copyable

ux.goal: ตรวจเหตุการณ์และ provenance ตาม actor/time/resource
ux.interaction: Filter authorized audit; open redacted detail; cursor history
ux.exception: No events for filter: clear; unavailable stream shows stale marker
ux.responsive: Chronological list; no fixed-width log dependency

blocks.label: Project identity and existing edit actions

ux.goal: ปรับ project metadata และ policies ตาม permission
ux.interaction: Edit allowed setting; review sensitive effect; dirty draft leave choice
ux.exception: Unsupported advanced option shows reason; no new implicit grant
ux.responsive: One section at a time, one action group

blocks.label: Dry-run changes, conflicts and target scope

ux.goal: นำเข้าแผนด้วย validate → preview → conflict → commit → receipt เดิม
ux.interaction: Preview parses data only; fix conflict; commit exact preview hash
ux.exception: Invalid JSON/schema shows location; unknown receipt reconciles
ux.responsive: Stepper vertical; preview diff/errors stack

ux.goal: เริ่มโปรเจกต์จาก objective และ Workspace เป้าหมาย
ux.interaction: Objective → workstreams (7 modes) → PlanEnvelope preview → existing writer
ux.exception: Missing objective/workspace blocks next; no template picker
ux.responsive: Short stepper; one-column inputs

blocks.label: Provider, endpoint and dated probe evidence

ux.goal: จัด Business registry แยก provider/model/MCP/key/executor/routing
ux.interaction: Tabs open setup; Project return link reauthorizes original scope
ux.exception: Empty registry: profile setup; denied admin no metadata
ux.responsive: Labeled tab selector; inspector stacks

ux.goal: ตั้ง model connection ตาม network/execution profile
ux.interaction: Connection → deployment → credential → probe/review/bind
ux.exception: Offline executor/unverified capability not healthy; save not probe
ux.responsive: Profile selector then conditional fieldsets

blocks.label: Auth profile, executor binding and consent

ux.goal: ตั้ง MCP แบบ remote HTTP หรือ paired STDIO
ux.interaction: Discover snapshot through broker; choose allowlist; review diff
ux.exception: Tool schema change stale; arbitrary command not accepted
ux.responsive: Transport first; endpoint/executor condition

screens.title: Inference API Keys
screens.safety: The wireframe contains no real key and accepts no secret; production reveals once after authorized issuance.

ux.goal: ออก inference key แบบ Project/model/quota/expiry scoped
ux.interaction: Review grant; one-time reveal after receipt; later metadata/revoke
ux.exception: Timeout needs lookup; secret never read back from metadata
ux.responsive: Grant summary before action; secret excluded from export

ux.goal: ดู enrolled executors, capability, heartbeat และ lease
ux.interaction: Open executor; authorized re-enroll/revoke with effect review
ux.exception: Offline/stale visible; revoke does not prove remote process stopped
ux.responsive: Health summary + lease list

screens.title: Routing & Budgets

blocks.label: Versioned routing policy and model eligibility
Priority, failover and data residency constraints

screens.safety: Cross-provider failover requires policy authorization; UNKNOWN side effects do not trigger automatic resubmission.

ux.goal: ตรวจ routing, fallback และ budget policy ที่มีสิทธิ์ใช้งาน
ux.interaction: Inspect authorized policy versions and constraints; policy editing/approval stays unavailable until a Business-scoped owner contract is approved
ux.exception: No authorized fallback blocks; UNKNOWN cannot auto-failover
ux.responsive: Policy steps stacked; candidate/active versions distinct

screens.contractLimit: The 72-operation candidate contract has Project ReviewInput only. It does not define a Business policy review operation. Never send a routing policy through Project reviews; define or bind the owner contract before P3 policy editing.
